title: Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP)

stage.name: Systems
stage.description: Pipes, wires and ducts run through the walls: the systems that keep a home alive.

intro: The things you don't see, until they stop working.

questions.prompt: Match each system to what it does.
pairs: Clean water in, used water out
questions.why: MEP is the heart, nerves and veins of a house.

questions.prompt: Why is the “rough-in” inspected before the walls are closed?
options: So inspectors can check the pipes and wires while they're still visible
questions.why: Once the walls are closed, problems are hidden and much harder to fix.

items: Run pipes and wires through the frame

questions.prompt: Communication runs behind the walls of a relationship. Which habit keeps it working?
options: Checking in regularly, not just when something breaks
Only talking when there's a problem
Guessing what the other person feels
questions.why: Regular check-ins catch small leaks before they become floods.

talk: How would you like to check in with each other: a walk, a call, a set time each week?
